name: SageMath MCP
tagline: Sandboxed SageMath for exact and symbolic mathematics
description: 40 tools over a sandboxed SageMath session that persists between calls: calculus, number theory, linear algebra, graphs, groups, elliptic curves, plotting, and verify_claim to re-check a stated result. Runs locally through uvx; the first launch downloads about 1 GB of Sage wheels (passagemath). macOS and Linux. An independent project by XBP Europe, not affiliated with the SageMath developers.
